notes.title: Small Patch - Progression and Upgrades
notes.notes:
- Now you can revisit the previous area and access it's upgrades, however you can't visit more than once to stockpile upgrades.

Once you die all the upgrades are lost, as usual.


- Fixed a small bug while fighting the first boss.

notes.title: Undergrave Release Date!!! (July 13)
notes.notes:
After 8 months of development, is finally here: Undergrave releases on July 13 on Steam and Epic Games Store.

Thank you very much everyone who followed the development, I hope you guys have fun playing how much I had making.
